slides.title: Prepare for production
slides.html:
Production

Prepare for production

  • Read the port and secrets from env
  • Add a start script
  • Allow your live frontend in CORS
  • Never commit .env

Backend

// package.json
"scripts": { "start": "node server.js" }
 
// server.js
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 5000;
app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.CLIENT_URL }));
 
app.get("/api/health", (req, res) =>
  res.json({ ok: true }));

slides.title: Deploy the API on Render
slides.html:
Render

Deploy the API on Render

1

New Web Service

render.com → New → Web Service → connect your GitHub repo

2

Settings

Build: npm install · Start: npm start · Root: backend (if needed)

3

Environment

Add MONGO_URI, JWT_SECRET, CLIENT_URL, AI_API_KEY

4

Check

Open https://your-api.onrender.com/api/health

slides.title: Deploy React on Netlify or Vercel
slides.html:
Frontend

Deploy React on Netlify or Vercel

1

Import

Connect the GitHub repo; Vite is detected automatically

2

Build

Build command: npm run build · Output: dist

3

Env var

Add VITE_API_URL = https://your-api.onrender.com/api

4

Routing

Add a redirect so refreshing /jobs/42 works

slides.title: Fix refresh on React Router pages
slides.html:
Routing

Fix refresh on React Router pages

public/_redirects (Netlify)

/*    /index.html   200

vercel.json (Vercel)

{
  "rewrites": [
    { "source": "/(.*)", "destination": "/" }
  ]
}

Without this, refreshing a page gives a 404

Test the live app

Fresh eyes

incognito + mobile

show a loading state

Portfolio

A README that gets you hired

  • Live link and a demo login
  • Features, stack and how to run it
  • What you learned and what's next

# JobHub
Find and post tech jobs in Nigeria.
 
**Live:** https://jobhub.netlify.app
**Demo login:** demo@jobhub.dev / demo1234
 
![screenshot](./screenshot.png)
 
## Features
- Sign up, post and manage jobs
- Search and filter by location
- ✨ AI-written job descriptions
 
## Tech
React · Express · MongoDB · JWT · Render · Netlify
